text: List the Aimparency MCP server in the public MCP registries
description: Major hypothesis loop 2026-11-02. RESEARCHED: developers find agent tooling through MCP catalogs and directories (e.g. https://skillselion.com/mcp/tool/io.github.mybolide/mcp-probe-kit, https://www.nuget.org/packages/speccodingmcpserver); spec/planning MCP servers are a visible category there. OBSERVED: the Aimparency MCP runs from source in this repo; it is not published as a package or listed anywhere. Needs a stdio entry that works from a fresh clone (or an npm package) and a registry entry naming the repo. Publishing under Felix's name is his decision.

status.comment: Question for Felix: may the Aimparency MCP be published (npm package and/or MCP registry entry) under your GitHub name now, or only after the Commons Hub trial? Publishing is outward-facing, so the agent will not do it on its own.
